Subject: Implementation plan: tracing hooks, dashboards, and runbook mapping (technical)

Jordan / SaaSCorp infra team — following our kickoff this morning (thanks for the time). This email captures the technical onboarding plan and the specific artifacts we'll deliver. Please reply with any constraints.

Summary deliverables (what Redwood will provide):
- Dashboards: per-route latency + p50/p95/p99, token-level cost, per-customer error-rate (sample Kibana/Grafana panels).
- Tracing: code snippet to add correlation_id header and an outgoing request hook; recommended Zipkin/Jaeger span attributes.
- Error taxonomy: classification doc mapping Redwood runtime exceptions to severity levels (critical/major/minor) and suggested automatic alert thresholds.
- Alert routing: PagerDuty integration + routing rules that dedupe by correlation_id and suppress expected transient spikes.
- Runbooks: 3 templated runbooks (High latency, Increased error rate, Backend model OOM) and owner recommendations.

Technical checklist and notes:
1) Staging access: please create a staging service account with the role "redwood-observability-integration" and email it to us. We only need read access to traces and logs for verification; we will not persist customer PII.
2) Tracing snippet (attached): add header "X-Request-Correlation" with a UUID and set span.tag "client.customer_id". Example (Python flask):

# tracing_hook_snippet.py (excerpt)
from uuid import uuid4

def add_correlation_header(request):
    cid = request.headers.get('X-Request-Correlation') or str(uuid4())
    request.headers['X-Request-Correlation'] = cid
    return request

3) Dashboard IDs: Once we provision dashboards in your Grafana instance we'll share dashboard IDs and a CSV of sample queries (see attached dashboard template).
4) Error taxonomy: we propose mapping Redwood runtime errors into three buckets:
   - Critical: model OOM, inference service crash (page immediately)
   - Major: >5% request error-rate over 5m window (alert to on-call)
   - Minor: transient 4xx from malformed prompts (log & ticket)

5) Alert routing rules: route Critical to on-call PD service (escalate after 5m), Major to platform slack channel + PD with low priority, Minor to backlog queue only. We will configure dedupe by X-Request-Correlation and add a 60s suppression window for bursty errors.

Runbook owners (proposed):
- High latency: SaaSCorp SRE (primary), Redwood CS (secondary)
- Increased error rate: SaaSCorp backend team (primary), Redwood support (secondary)
- Model OOM: SaaSCorp ML infra (primary), Redwood runtime engineering (secondary)

Next steps and timeline:
- Wed 2025-03-12: Redwood pushes a validation payload to staging and confirms traces are visible.
- Fri 2025-03-14: Draft runbooks and dashboard prototypes shared for review.
- Tue 2025-03-18: Staging sign-off (customer to validate).

Please confirm staging service account and PagerDuty token. Happy to hop on a short 30m call if you prefer a live walkthrough.
